title: SOTA/efficiency/numerical-stability steering
description: Advisory steering across gsd's plan/execute/verify/ship lifecycle toward SOTA numerics: internally and project-consistent, unambiguous, complete, efficient, quiet-running, agent-facing code -- plus the single blocking plan:post gate that mechanically enforces a compliant Alternatives Considered section on every plan in a phase. No new gate covers the added dimensions.

sota-numerics.enabled.description: Master toggle for both the advisory steering fragments and the blocking plan:post Alternatives Considered gate — the only config key this capability declares.

predicate.command: SOTA_SCRIPT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.gsd/capabilities/sota-numerics/scripts/check-alternatives.py"; [ -f "$SOTA_SCRIPT" ] || SOTA_SCRIPT="${GSD_HOME:-$HOME}/.gsd/capabilities/sota-numerics/scripts/check-alternatives.py"; test -f "$SOTA_SCRIPT" || { echo "sota-numerics: gate script not found at project or global scope -- run 'gsd capability install sota-numerics' (or reopen the session to let the SessionStart auto-install run)" >&2; exit 1; }; python3 "$SOTA_SCRIPT" "${PHASE_DIR}"

gates.description: onError is deliberately "halt", diverging from every other gate in this repo (beads' two ship:pre gates both use "skip"): this governs only the check COMMAND itself failing to run (missing python3, crash, timeout) — the block decision comes separately, from the exit code, via gsd-core's generic command-exit-zero evaluator. A blocking gate that silently skips on its own command failure defeats its purpose. Do not "fix" this back to "skip".
